q1_issues.issue: "in the Watch ledgers" is the medium the record is written into rather than where the recording happened, so by the instruction set's own "in a statement" case it should be the preposition-named oblique `(In ...)` rather than `Location`.

q2_gaps: a capitalized common-noun label used as a premodifier of another common noun ("the Watch ledgers") — the premodifier rule is written for a proper noun, while the label rule makes "the Watch" a common noun with no `Name`, so no rule names the link between head and premodifier
notes: The rest follows the instruction set closely: the copular-with-time state reification plus flat dual-emit, the compound genus atoms for `mire_essence`/`lantern_station`, the proper-noun-premodifier `Possession` pattern for the Northcove stations, the group event plus per-member distribution rule at STV 1.0 0.9, event anaphora reusing `sk_redistribute_1`, and no connective atoms for bare juxtaposition. `Possession` for "the stations of the Middle Row" is the debatable one — the part/member test arguably gives `PartOf` — but the opaque fallback is defensible.
